title: Frontend: Event Management
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Event Management. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Inputs Title, Start, End name=title/start/end add daily events using integer hours 0..24 with start<end. Add[data-action=add] rejects invalid fields with Invalid event, or overlap with Overlap. Intervals are half-open; adjacent events allowed. Render li[data-event=ID], Delete[data-delete=ID], sequential IDs. This bounded daily interval model omits timezones/recurrence.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Store stable event IDs and distinguish instants from local calendar entries.
alternativeApproaches: Add recurrence with a timezone-aware rule model and define how exceptions and rescheduling are represented.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Adjacent events; exact overlap; invalid interval.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
